purpose: Pre-registered joint source- and near-clone-isolated split for the expanded AMR cohort

rules.unit: drug x identity representative with an S/R label
rules.components: union by near-clone group, declared source projects (source_projects), ENA study accessions and BioProject
rules.joint: one partition across drugs; each BioSample keeps the same partition in every task
rules.assignment: whole components; seeded greedy by labeled-unit deficit; per drug >= min_groups groups and both classes in every partition
rules.conflicts: mixed-label clone groups flagged per drug; excluded from the primary analysis downstream
rules.source_missing: components without any declared source are allowed in training but must not support source-independent test claims
